brand.name: FORM/SHIFT
brand.tagline: Independent design studio for identities, digital products and moving systems.
brand.description: FORM/SHIFT is an independent design studio shaping identities, digital experiences and motion systems for ambitious cultural and technology brands.

hero.lead: Strategy, identity, digital experience and motion—built as one coherent visual operating system.

headline.text: A studio for brands that need more than a

paragraphs: We work at the point where identity, interface and motion become one system. The output can be a launch, a platform, a campaign or a complete reframe of how a brand behaves.
Our process is compact, senior-led and prototype-first. We make ideas tangible early, then refine every layer until the experience feels inevitable.

principles.title: Clarity before decoration
principles.body: Every visual move must strengthen the idea, hierarchy or action.

principles.title: Motion is structure
principles.body: Transitions explain relationships, not just add spectacle.

principles.title: Systems beat screens
principles.body: We design rules that keep producing quality after launch.

work.lead: Identity and digital work for technology, culture, hospitality and next-generation products.

projects.title: Aether Objects
projects.description: A tactile identity and immersive product system for a collectible objects label built around light, material and seriality.

projects.title: Field Notes 02
projects.description: A cinematic publishing platform where essays, audio and archival imagery move through a single spatial reading rhythm.

projects.title: NOVA/AI
projects.description: A responsive product language translating invisible model behavior into a calm, legible interaction system.

projects.title: Still / Moving
projects.description: A quiet hospitality identity built from changing light, soft typography and a digital concierge that shifts with time of day.

capabilities.lead: We assemble the smallest senior team needed to move from strategic idea to launch-ready expression without losing coherence.

items.title: Brand systems
items.body: Positioning and identity systems with enough logic to scale across teams, markets and media.

items.title: Digital experiences
items.body: Websites and products that turn brand principles into interface behavior and interaction rhythm.

items.title: Motion language
items.body: Kinetic identities, launch films and interface motion where timing becomes part of the brand voice.

items.title: Creative technology
items.body: Generative graphics, WebGL and spatial prototypes used when a concept deserves a medium of its own.

method.lead: A four-stage process with decisions, prototypes and critique built into every step.

steps.title: Frame
steps.body: Define the real design problem, audience, constraints and the decision the work needs to unlock.

steps.title: Explore
steps.body: Build contrasting visual territories and motion tests before committing to one predictable answer.

steps.title: Systemize
steps.body: Turn the chosen direction into repeatable rules across typography, imagery, layout, motion and UI.

steps.title: Launch
steps.body: Prototype edge cases, polish transitions, prepare assets and support implementation through release.

studio.body: FORM/SHIFT is an independent design practice working with founders, cultural teams and product leaders. Core direction stays close to the work; specialists join when the idea needs type, code, 3D, film or sound.

proof.quote: They found the one visual idea that made the product suddenly feel obvious—and then carried it through every detail.
